data.gender_notes: Ashish is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashish is derived from the Sanskrit term 'ash' meaning 'happiness, joy' and 'ish' meaning 'lord, god, giver'. This name is often given to a boy born during a joyful and prosperous time. The name Ashish carries the meaning “Happy, Joyful, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashish usually hope their child will grow to embody happy, joyful, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
